adaptive_screen_stop.reason: Adaptive cheap screen: stop after first complete CPU matched pair before expensive confirmation under shared-host contention. Firstbaseline scheduled0.617cores; one pair is not qualification. Allcomplete results retained; next started process ifany is partial/excluded. May extend if actual evidence warrants, otherwise discard runtime. No unrelated processes touched.

validation.strict_nbt: Every measured payload matches existing same-backend golden, lighting/structures/blockentities/heightmaps/metadata included. Native actual backend checked from completed runs.
validation.byte_attribution: All5120measured attribution payload byte totals equal actual decompressed MCA,5receipts. Warmups identified by8,8 separately.
validation.unit_tests: Draft palette-unit added to private prototype but NOT run; discarded with all runtime code. No new unit test or runtime implementation shipped.
validation.actual_minecraft_decode: No new consumer change or decode-speed claim. Codec cycle10already performs actual Minecraft decoding; this discarded prototype does not replace expanded validation required for a retained runtime change.
validation.builds: All4 private/fresh native builds compile successfully with recorded same Rust1.93.0/LLVM21.1.8/releaseThinLTO2CG/defaultfeatures/Cargo.lock settings.
validation.diff_check: PASS; runtime tree restored exactly before documentation commit.

limitations: Screens are deliberately not5matchedpairs; none of this code is retained or claimed as qualified. Changing extreme host load makes +22% CPUwall insufficient: CPUwork -1.14% with scheduledcores .617->.746.
Six phase timers are disjoint worker-elapsed spans inside encode_chunk, including clock/preemption overhead; may overlap across workers and are not utilization percentages.
Cold NBTscratch count is first nonempty Vec use; capacitygrowth is positive ending-minus-starting logicalcapacity, not allocator count, DRAMtraffic, retainedmemory orRSS.
Path counters count CPU palette-builder attempts including uniformdense values; uniformfastpath andGPU-packed paths separate.
Normal CPU/Metal, MetalNether/outerEnd attribution and normal CPU/Metalprototype screens only. Rejected code is not qualified for newseed/custom/tall/partialpublication/cancellation.
Windows compact transport/default qualification remains pending. No Windows performance claim, default switch, JAR build or release.
next_opportunity: Separate O3 direct-sky row-major initialization using exact existing frontier state; prior helper attribution ~25/55ms synthetic phase. Not part of this discarded palette trial and not a claimed performance win.

build_process_policy.scope: After verifying ownership, taskpolicy -B applied to candidate compiler33730 only; no system/other-process changes. No causal compile-time speedup claim.
